reasoning_summary: The defect is a classic algorithmic error where the procedure for calculating the final index in a multidimensional array was implemented incorrectly. The fix replaces the entire faulty loop-based logic with a correct arithmetic expression. This is not a missing check (Checking), not a simple initialization error (Assignment/Initialization), and not a design-level capability gap (Function/Class/Object).
